{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Education for citizenship requires developing the ability to think critically, to question received wisdom and willingness to challenge authority.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Education at all levels must be funded adequately, with special attention paid to schools in low-income communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Teaching must become a high status profession.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Teachers and teachers’ unions must be protected from scapegoating for other failures in the system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The institutions of tenure and faculty-shared governance must be defended because they are integral to the liberating education sought.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The “business model” of the university must be resisted.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Every human being is capable of learning and acquiring knowledge and skills.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Society as a whole has the responsibility to ensure that each individual go as far on the path of education as they are capable and desire.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Everyone has the right to give and receive care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"There are 40 million children in the United States under age 10 and approximately 50 million elderly and/or disabled.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Both children under age 10 and the elderly and/or disabled need caring support with many of the basic tasks of daily life.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Care and support should be provided both by family members as well as by professionally trained, respected and well-paid care providers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"There are 40 million children in the United States under age 10 and approximately 50 million elderly and/or disabled.",
